# Jayaraj Dental Clinic

> Experienced general dentists and specialists, with a temple gopuram view on East Mada Street — and a branch in Mandaveli.

Website: https://jayarajdentalclinic.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: 044 4210 1660

## Contact

- Jayaraj Dental Clinic — Mandaveli · R.K. Mutt Road, near St. Luke's Church, Mandaveli, Chennai 600 028 · Mornings by appointment · evenings 5.30–8.30 pm · 044 4281 5886

## Key facts
- practice began in Mylapore 1972
- 5 dental operatories
- 1,500 sq ft clinic

## Facilities
- Laser dentistry
- Full mouth rehabilitation
- Sedation dentistry
- Teeth alignment & braces
- Invisible & lingual braces
- Preventive & child care
- Implant surgery
- Gum surgery
- Root canal treatment
- Tooth whitening
- Painless extractions
- X-ray unit

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Jayaraj Dental Clinic?
15/2, East Mada Street (opposite ICICI Bank), Mylapore, Chennai 600 004 (Weekdays 9.30 am–12.30 pm, 5.30–9.30 pm · Sundays 10 am–12 pm).

### What facilities does Jayaraj Dental Clinic have?
Laser dentistry, Full mouth rehabilitation, Sedation dentistry, Teeth alignment & braces, Invisible & lingual braces, Preventive & child care, Implant surgery, Gum surgery, Root canal treatment, Tooth whitening, Painless extractions, X-ray unit.

### What are your timings?
Mylapore: weekdays 9.30 am to 12.30 pm and 5.30 to 9.30 pm; Sundays 10 am to 12 pm. Mandaveli: mornings by appointment, evenings 5.30 to 8.30 pm.

### Do you treat children?
Yes — preventive care, fluoride, sealants, tooth-coloured fillings and treatment for milk teeth.

### How do I book at Jayaraj Dental Clinic?
Pick a date on this page and send it, or call 044 4210 1660.
